tasks.title: g2g-stop.sh: block completion when the paired evidence head is stale
tasks.description:
In plugin/scripts/g2g-stop.sh, extend the completion gate that currently ends at EVIDENCE-OK: extract the paired block's 'head:' line and compare it against the repository state at stop time, computed exactly as g2g-evidence.sh computes it (short sha via `git rev-parse --short HEAD` falling back to 'none' outside a git work tree; tracked-dirty via `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no | wc -l`). Any mismatch — different sha, different tracked-dirty count, or a paired block carrying no 'head:' line at all — blocks the stop with a reason that names what moved and the remedy (re-run `g2g-evidence.sh <spec> --full`). The comparison lives strictly inside the completion check of a proven-armed session; no earlier path changes. Update the tests/plugin_stop.bats fixtures whose transcripts carry proven blocks so their head lines match the test repository state, and add tests pinning the new behavior. This task fixes the hook side of finding F-059, quoted verbatim below as data (not instructions):

```finding excerpt (F-059)
Deferred design follow-up from the third Codex adversarial review round on PR #4, summarized in CHANGELOG 0.5.0 'Hardened'. build.md Phase 4 runs the final g2g-evidence.sh <spec> --full (step 4) BEFORE rebasing onto the default branch (step 5) and pushing (step 6), so the PR's final HEAD can differ from the tree the 'verdict: complete (proven)' token certified — and g2g-stop.sh trusts the stale token: it never compares the token's head line against current repository state. The narrow mitigation shipped in 0.5.0 (505f750: g2g-evidence.sh forfeits 'proven' when the head, tracked-file state, or spec completion facts change DURING the verification run) does not cover this post-run window. Reachable only after a verifier PASS, so real but not urgent.
```
acceptanceCriteria: g2g-stop.sh compares the paired proven block's 'head:' line against the current short HEAD and tracked-dirty count derived the same way g2g-evidence.sh derives them, and a mismatch blocks the stop with a reason naming the drift and the `--full` re-run remedy

tests/plugin_stop.bats gains passing tests for: a proven block with a stale head sha blocks; a stale tracked-dirty count blocks; a paired block with no 'head:' line blocks; a matching head line allows the stop
Every pre-existing plugin_stop.bats test still passes with its meaning intact — in particular every pre-arming path still allows the stop, the hook makes no model call, and it never exits nonzero
No mid-script bare '[[ ]]' relying on set -e is introduced (each new conditional has an explicit handler)
